title: rubus murinus
intro: Rubus murinus, commonly known as the Himalayan Raspberry or Himalayan Bramble, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is native to the Himalayan region and is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to boost immunity and aid in the treatment of various health issues such as fever, digestive problems, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Rubus murinus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and protect the body from oxidative stress. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
